• Own Messaging end-to-end. This covers list growth and consent capture, campaigns, automations, two-way conversations, and reporting. You’ll define the core flows, ship them, instrument them and iterate.

You’ll decide how the product shows intent, respects owner constraints and brand voice, and knows when to hand a conversation back to a human. • Pick the right leading indicators. About Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms
Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms (ACO&P) is a net-new digital product organization within Cyber Operations, building the shared technology foundation for how modern cyber defense operates.
Our north star is an adaptive, engineering-led, AI-powered cyber operations platform that brings together high-fidelity security data, integrated tooling, AI, and automation to help defenders detect threats earlier, turn security telemetry into actionable intelligence, accelerate decision-making, and respond at machine speed.

Our mission is to connect the cyber operations lifecycle end to end, turning signals into trusted intelligence, intelligence into decisions, and decisions into protection. By reducing fragmentation and intelligently applying AI and automation, ACO&P enables cyber defenders to focus their expertise where human judgment matters most while building a cyber operations ecosystem that continuously adapts to an evolving threat landscape.

About the Role

As a Lead Digital Product Manager in ACO&P, you will lead a portfolio of capabilities within the cyber operations ecosystem, shaping the product strategy for how those capabilities are delivered, measured, and continuously improved. As the portfolio evolves, you will identify, shape, and scale the capabilities that deliver the greatest value across Cyber Operations, balancing near-term needs with the long-term integrity, adoption, and outcomes of the platform.

You will lead and develop Digital Product Managers and partner closely with engineering leaders and Cyber Operations stakeholders to translate strategy into measurable outcomes, product roadmaps, and durable capabilities.

Open Roles
We are hiring Lead Digital Product Managers for three distinct portfolios. Each role shares the responsibilities and required qualifications below; the role profiles that follow describe the specific focus, capabilities, and preferred qualifications for each portfolio.

Accountabilities (All Roles):
• Define and own the product vision, strategy, outcomes, and roadmap for your portfolio, aligned to the ACO&P north star.
• Lead, coach, and grow Digital Product Managers, building strong product practices in discovery, outcome definition, roadmapping, prioritization, and measurement.
• Define measurable product outcomes and KPIs that connect your portfolio's performance, adoption, and user experience to Cyber Operations outcomes.
• Translate complex Cyber Operations needs into a coherent product strategy, balancing immediate priorities with the foundational capabilities needed to unlock future value.
• Drive connected capabilities that build on shared data, integrations, platform, workflow, and orchestration capabilities rather than isolated point solutions.
• Define clear product boundaries, decision rights, and partnership models with adjacent teams across Cyber Operations, enterprise platforms, and engineering.
• Advance AI and automation responsibly, establishing the product principles and guardrails needed for safe, auditable, and increasingly agentic cyber operations.
• Guide build, buy, integrate, and retire decisions based on long-term value, user needs, resilience, interoperability, and portfolio integrity.
• Stay close to defenders and the work, using continuous discovery, observation, product data, and feedback to understand friction, validate assumptions, and measure adoption and outcomes.
• Communicate strategy, progress, evidence, and trade-offs to Cyber Operations leadership and stakeholders, resolving tensions between local needs and ecosystem-wide outcomes.

Qualifications (All Roles):
• 8+ years of experience in digital product management, platform product leadership, or enterprise product delivery, with demonstrated experience leading, coaching, or influencing product teams.
• Demonstrated success leading outcome-driven products, platforms, or portfolios in complex enterprise environments.
• Track record of outcome-driven product management, including defining measurable outcomes, establishing baselines, using data to inform decisions, and prioritizing roadmaps against those outcomes.
• Strong stakeholder leadership with the ability to align engineering, platform, security, risk, and business partners around shared outcomes, priorities, and clear ownership boundaries.
• Excellent strategic communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and operational topics clear and actionable for both executives and practitioners.

Role Profiles and Bonus Qualifications

Bonus Qualifications (All Roles):
• Background in cybersecurity operations, such as SOC operations, incident response, threat intelligence, threat hunting, or detection engineering.
• Experience enabling AI and automation at scale, including agentic AI governance concepts such as guardrails, auditability, human oversight, and safe actions.

Role 1: Lead Digital Product Manager – Cyber Intelligence Platform

Lead the foundational platform that turns security telemetry into trusted, decision-ready intelligence and connects it to the tools and workflows defenders use every day, reducing fragmentation and accelerating the path from signal to decision to action.

Focus Areas
• Trusted security data: make telemetry reliable, timely, observable, and enriched, with shared data standards that improve quality and interoperability across the ecosystem.
• Connected operating experience: bring intelligence, tools, workflows, and AI together so defenders can investigate, decide, and respond with less friction.
• Decision intelligence and trusted AI: turn security context into prioritized insights and safe automated actions, and enable AI agents to interact safely with security data and tools.
• Extensible platform: drive reusable integrations, APIs, orchestration, and platform patterns that serve multiple Cyber Operations teams.
• Success is measured by platform health, adoption, user experience, and operational effectiveness across Cyber Operations.

Bonus Qualifications – Cyber Intelligence Platform
• Demonstrated success owning platform or data products used by multiple internal teams.
• Experience with security data, observability, telemetry pipelines, or SIEM and analytics ecosystems, such as Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Data Explorer, Cribl, or similar technologies.
• Familiarity with KQL-style analytics, data normalization and schemas, and data quality and health concepts.
• Experience building or leading internal developer or operator platforms, golden paths, APIs, orchestration, or workflow capabilities.
• Experience with context enrichment, knowledge graphs, or decision-support products.

Role 2: Lead Digital Product Manager – Security Operations Missions

Lead the mission-focused capabilities that turn intelligence into protection, helping Cyber Operations discover threats earlier, investigate and respond faster, reduce exposure, and automate repetitive operational work.

Focus Areas
• Threat discovery and intelligence: connect threat intelligence, hunting, detection, and security context to improve coverage, reduce noise, and focus on the highest-value threats.
• Investigation and response: enable faster, more consistent investigation, containment, and response through connected workflows, decision support, and automation.
• Exposure intelligence: combine vulnerability, threat, and business context to prioritize the exposures that matter most and measure risk reduction through remediation.
• Scalable mission capabilities: work with frontline teams to turn workflows, decision logic, and response patterns into reusable, increasingly automated capabilities.
• Success is measured by detection effectiveness, time to investigate and contain, exposure reduction, analyst effort, and automation effectiveness.

Bonus Qualifications – Security Operations Missions
• Experience partnering closely with operational teams to translate frontline workflows and pain points into products that achieve measurable outcomes.
• Familiarity with security operations technologies and workflows, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence, security analytics, and case management.
• Familiarity with threat and exposure frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, threat-informed defense, and risk-based vulnerability prioritization.
• Experience with insider threat or vulnerability and exposure management.
• Experience building products that connect intelligence, operational workflows, and decision-making across multiple teams or systems.

Role 3: Lead Digital Product Manager – Endpoint & Data Defense

Lead the products that protect Allstate's endpoints and data across the enterprise and acquired businesses, moving from reactive, incident-driven control changes to proactive, threat-informed risk reduction while keeping friction low for end users.

Focus Areas
• Endpoint coverage: protect every workstation, server, Mac, Linux, virtual desktop, and cloud workload, with clear visibility into gaps and compensating controls.
• Prevention and hardening: advance EDR, privilege management, and application control that block malicious activity by default, deployed ahead of emerging threats with threat intelligence, hunting, and purple teams.
• Data protection: evolve capabilities such as data loss prevention, encryption, removable media and data movement controls, and malware scanning of stored data.
• Detection quality and containment: deliver high-fidelity telemetry, well-tuned policies, and reliable device isolation for detection, response, and threat hunting teams.
• Portfolio rationalization: define clear scope with adjacent teams, retire overlapping tools, and break large policy and deployment changes into smaller, lower-risk increments.
• Success is measured by coverage, prevention, detection, containment, risk reduction, and user experience.

Bonus Qualifications – Endpoint & Data Defense
• Experience with endpoint security and data protection capabilities, such as EDR, endpoint privilege management, application control, DLP, encryption, or device control, using technologies like CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview, BeyondTrust, or similar.
• Familiarity with large, heterogeneous endpoint environments and the trade-offs between protection and user experience.
• Familiarity with threat-informed defense, MITRE ATT&CK, control validation, and purple team practices.
• Experience with control governance and risk management, including coverage measurement, exception and risk-acceptance processes, and audit readiness.
• Experience bringing multiple environments or acquired businesses onto common platforms, standards, and controls.

À propos des Opérations et plateformes de cybersécurité fondées sur l’IA agentique
Les Opérations et plateformes de cybersécurité fondées sur l’IA agentique constituent une nouvelle organisation de produits numériques au sein des Opérations de cybersécurité, une équipe qui établit les bases technologiques communes pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de la cyberdéfense moderne.
Notre objectif phare est de créer une plateforme d’opérations de cybersécurité adaptative, axée sur l’ingénierie et alimentée par l’IA qui réunit des données de sécurité de haute fidélité, des outils intégrés, l’IA et l’automatisation pour aider les défenseurs à détecter les menaces plus tôt, à transformer la télémétrie de sécurité en renseignement exploitable, à accélérer la prise de décisions et à répondre à la vitesse de la machine.

Notre mission est de relier chaque stade du cycle de vie des opérations de cybersécurité, de transformer les signaux en renseignements fiables, le renseignement en décisions et les décisions en mesures de protection. En réduisant la fragmentation et en appliquant intelligemment l’IA et l’automatisation, les Opérations et plateformes de cybersécurité fondées sur l’IA agentique permettent aux défenseurs de la cybersécurité de concentrer leur expertise là où le jugement humain compte le plus, tout en bâtissant un écosystème d’opérations de cybersécurité qui s’adapte sans cesse à un paysage de menaces en constante évolution.

À propos du poste

À titre de gestionnaire principal·e de produits numériques au sein d’Opérations et plateformes de cybersécurité fondées sur l’IA agentique, vous dirigerez un portefeuille de capacités au sein de l’écosystème des opérations de cybersécurité et établirez la stratégie de produits qui encadrera la manière dont ces capacités sont fournies, mesurées et continuellement améliorées. À mesure que le portefeuille évoluera, vous déterminerez, façonnerez et développerez les capacités qui offrent la plus grande valeur à l’échelle des Opérations de cybersécurité, en équilibrant les besoins à court terme avec l’intégrité, l’adoption et les résultats à long terme de la plateforme.

Vous dirigerez et formerez des gestionnaires de produits numériques et collaborerez étroitement avec les responsables de l’ingénierie et les intervenants des Opérations de cybersécurité pour traduire la stratégie en résultats mesurables, en feuilles de route des produits et en capacités durables.

Postes à pourvoir

Les postes ont les mêmes responsabilités et exigencesrequises (ci-dessous); les profils de rôle ci-après décrivent l’orientation, les capacités et les exigences privilégiées propres à chaque portefeuille.

• Diriger, encadrer et former les gestionnaires de produits numériques, en développant de solides pratiques produits dans les domaines de la découverte, de la définition des résultats, de la création de feuilles de route, de l’établissement des priorités et de la mesure.
• Définir des résultats mesurables et des indicateurs clés de rendement qui établissent un lien entre le rendement, l’adoption et l’expérience des utilisateurs pour les produits de votre portefeuille et les résultats des Opérations de cybersécurité.
• Traduire les besoins complexes des Opérations de cybersécurité en une stratégie de produit cohérente, en équilibrant les priorités immédiates avec les capacités fondamentales nécessaires pour produire de la valeur.
• Promouvoir des capacités connectées qui s’appuient sur des données mises en commun, des intégrations, la plateforme, des flux de travail et des capacités d’orchestration plutôt que sur des solutions ponctuelles isolées.

Poste 2 : Gestionnaire en chef de produits numériques (missions des opérations de sécurité)
